notes: Volunteer Office: (714) 378-7000, Mon to Fri 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Patient Care Pavilion, 18111 Brookhurst St. The application PDF was not checked.
name: Orange Coast Medical Center Volunteer
what_you_do: Volunteer in the hospital as part of the patient care team. You work in service areas. After an interview, the Volunteer Office finds you an opening.
who_can_apply: Anyone 16 or older. Those 18 and over also pass a background check and need a valid Social Security number. You commit to 150 hours a year.
pay_detail: Unpaid. If accepted you pay a $25 registration fee.
how_to_apply: Fill out the PDF application form and email it to the Volunteer Office. Then do an interview, an orientation, two TB tests and a flu shot.
